description: Lists exercise clips cut from your uploaded videos that wait for you to accept or reject, or the team's uploads by processing status. Use when the user asks what needs review, which uploads are done, or why an upload failed. Not for library exercises already accepted (use list_team_exercises). Returns clip IDs for review_uploads (kind clips), or upload IDs with status (kind uploads), with has_more for paging.

kind.description: What to list: clips = clips from your own uploads waiting for review; uploads = the team's uploaded videos and their processing status. Defaults to clips.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

status.description: Upload status, with kind uploads only: ready = clips ready for you to review; processing = still processing; waiting = queued for quality check; in_review = in quality check; failed = processing failed; rejected = rejected in quality check; all = every status. Defaults to ready.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: list_uploads_to_review
title: List uploads to review
